argv: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'agentos_node.client_cli.*run'} | Select-Object -First 1; if(-not $p){throw 'thin_client_process_not_found'}; $pid0=$p.ProcessId; $cmd="Start-Sleep -Seconds 3; Stop-Process -Id $pid0 -Force"; Start-Process powershell.exe -WindowStyle Hidden -ArgumentList @('-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',$cmd); Write-Output ('scheduled_kill_pid='+$pid0)
